_description: Parts catalog for the ChiMesh v0 build — 3 solar-powered RAK4631 Meshtastic nodes for proof-of-mesh in Chicago. Prices are per node; the page widget multiplies by node count. All ten parts are compatibility-checked end-to-end: Solar panel (5V) -> TP5000 (LFP-configured) -> LiFePO4 cell -> JST-PHR-2 on RAK19003 -> RAK4631 -> IPEX -> SMA pigtail -> 915 MHz antenna.
pricesNote: Per-node estimates in USD. Stock varies; verify via the Google Shopping link on each card before ordering.

categories.core: Required for every node — one of each per node.
categories.consumable: Cheap misc parts you may already have. Order once, share across all 3 nodes.

parts.name: RAK4631 WisBlock Core (nRF52840 + SX1262 LoRa)
parts.note: The brain. Nordic nRF52840 MCU with Semtech SX1262 LoRa radio on one module. Listens at ~7 mA (vs ~17 mA for Heltec V3) which is what makes solar viable in Chicago winter. Make sure you get the 915 MHz US variant, not the 868 MHz EU variant.

specs.label: Radio
specs.value: Semtech SX1262 LoRa, up to +22 dBm

specs.label: Frequency
specs.value: 915 MHz (US) — pick correct SKU for region

specs.label: Sleep
specs.value: ~3 µA System OFF, ~7 µA w/ RAM retain

parts.name: RAK19003 WisBlock Mini Base Board
parts.note: Carrier board for the RAK4631. Adds USB-C (for flashing only — do NOT use to charge LFP), JST-PHR-2 battery connector, and IPEX antenna pass-through. The Mini variant is the smallest base and fits inside a 100x68x50mm enclosure with room for the cell and panel cable.

parts.name: LiFePO4 18650 Cell (IFR18650, ~1500 mAh)
parts.note: MUST be LiFePO4 (LFP / IFR18650), NOT Li-ion. Chicago winters charge below 0°C; Li-ion plates lithium permanently in those conditions and kills the cell in one winter. LFP charges safely to ~-10°C and lasts 2000-5000 cycles vs 500-1000 for Li-ion. Half the mAh in the same form factor is the price of admission.

parts.name: Single 18650 Battery Holder with Leads
parts.note: Plain plastic single-cell holder with pre-soldered red/black wires. Get the 'with leads' variant, not the PCB-mount type — you need wires you can crimp into the JST-PHR-2 connector on the RAK19003.

parts.name: TP5000 Solar Charge Controller (LFP-configurable)
parts.note: CRITICAL: this board has a jumper that selects between Li-ion (4.2 V termination) and LFP (3.6 V termination). Set it for LFP before connecting. Stock charge controllers in cheap solar lamps are tuned for Li-ion and will damage an LFP cell — that is why we bypass anything that came with the panel and use this module instead. Solar panel goes to this module's IN+/IN-; LFP cell connects to its BAT+/BAT-; the BAT output then feeds the RAK19003 JST-PHR-2 directly.

specs.label: Input
specs.value: 4.5–8 V DC (5 V solar panel fits)

specs.label: Chemistry
specs.value: Li-ion 4.2 V OR LFP 3.6 V via jumper

specs.label: MPPT
specs.value: No (linear) — fine for 2 W class panels

parts.name: 5V / 2W Monocrystalline Solar Panel (~110 x 80 mm)
parts.note: Sized for the Chicago winter floor: ~150-200 mAh/day harvest in December assuming 1.5 peak sun hours and a slightly dirty panel face. Summer harvests 3-5x more, plenty of margin. Open-circuit voltage ~6.5 V, MPP ~5 V; pairs cleanly with the TP5000 input range. Output wires usually bare — terminate into the TP5000 IN+/IN- screw terminal or solder.

parts.name: 915 MHz SMA Antenna (~5 dBi rubber duck)
parts.note: Must be SMA (not RP-SMA). Match the frequency to your region — 915 MHz for US/AU, 868 MHz for EU, 433 MHz for AS923. A 5 dBi whip gives the best size-vs-range tradeoff for proof-of-mesh; upgrade to a fiberglass colinear (8+ dBi) later if you put a node on a rooftop. Antenna stays vertical for matching polarization with the rest of the Meshtastic network.

parts.name: IPEX (u.FL) to SMA Pigtail, ~10 cm
parts.note: The RAK4631 module has an IPEX (u.FL) antenna footprint; this cable adapts it to a standard SMA bulkhead through the enclosure wall. Get the female-SMA-bulkhead version (panel-mount nut) so it threads through the hole you drill in the case. RG178 coax is standard; 100–150 mm is the right length for a 100 mm box.

specs.label: End B
specs.value: SMA female bulkhead w/ panel nut

parts.name: IP65 ABS Weatherproof Junction Box (~100 x 68 x 50 mm)
parts.note: Cheap clear or grey ABS box from any hardware site. IP65 is enough for a vertical wall mount; if you flat-mount it skyward, look for IP66+. Internal volume fits the RAK19003 + Mini base + 18650 holder + TP5000 + slack cable. Drill one hole on top/side for the antenna SMA bulkhead and one on the bottom for the panel cable gland.

parts.name: M12 IP68 Cable Gland (for solar panel pass-through)
parts.note: Threaded gland that seals around the solar panel's output cable as it enters the enclosure. M12 fits a small drilled hole; M16 if you have a thicker cable. Skip if you'd rather use silicone sealant in a smaller hole, but the gland is reusable when you swap parts.

parts.name: JST-PHR-2 connectors + 22 AWG silicone wire + M3 screws
parts.note: Buy once, share across all 3 nodes. JST-PHR-2 male housings + crimp terminals connect the battery holder leads to the RAK19003. 22 AWG silicone-jacket wire handles all the low-voltage hops cleanly. M3x6 / M3x8 screws + double-sided VHB foam tape mount the panel and board to the enclosure interior.

specs.label: JST
specs.value: PHR-2 housings + crimp pins (2.0 mm pitch)

specs.label: Wire
specs.value: 22 AWG silicone, red + black, ~1 m each

specs.label: Tape
specs.value: 3M VHB or generic foam, ~25 mm wide
